body:
subject: re: evening state — #1946 and #1949 are waiting on YOU (4th notice, with the exact steps); TASK-1284/1285 approved+queued; TASK-163 is drain

Good evening's work on the four rework rounds. Two corrections that keep recurring in your status mails, stated as plainly as I can:

#1946 (STORY-1226) is NOT at my gate. Its head is still 3cbaf17c, the commit you opened it with at 15:09. My round-1 CHANGES REQUESTED has been in your inbox since 15:20 (mail c4215b27; verdict file .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1946-advisor.json). Three fixes, then push to the same branch:
  1. schedule_ledger::write_cas_opts — call git_ops::ensure_store_write_safe(store_root)? at the top and return Ok(()) with a one-line note when it refuses (BUG-1229 class on a per-turn hook path).
  2. tick_core `on` jobs — when a job has no last_seen_event_ts AND no last_run, set the cursor to now and record it; do not scan historical events on first sight.
  3. maintenance_schedule::load_global_config — only fall back to the bare ScheduleConfig parse when the file body has no `schedule` key; otherwise return the parse error.
  Then: git push origin story-1226. I re-review the delta and ship the same tick.

#1949 (BUG-1241 docs) is NOT green at my gate. Its head is still eff3c42b. My round-1 comment is ON THE PR (16:0x): revert the two docs/plans hunks (2026-06-07-story-527-aida-burndown-sketch.md — that line is a `list --tags` FILTER, `list` has no --add-tag; and 2026-06-26-task-0438-fasttrack-lane.md — dated plans stay frozen), keep CLAUDE.md + glossary.yaml + 12-glossary.md. Then push. I ship.

If either of those mails did not reach you, say so and I will re-send; if they did, please act on them before staging another wave — TASK-1280/1281 are parked behind #1946 and that is entirely in your hands.

Other items: TASK-163 is execution_mode drain in the store (set 12:11) — your "mode unset" is a stale read; run aida cache verify --fix on your side. TASK-1284 (lease-based liveness) and TASK-1285 (binary pinning + rebuild handoff) are approved, DRIVE, tagged batch:followups-0918h and queued — both hold for my gate. BUG-1236 by hand is still open on your side (mail 17:33).
